Name: Morà Busoli
HQ Location: Italy, Emilia-romagna, Mirandola, Via Di Mezzo, 41037
Company description: Morà, the name of the project pursued by the 100% Italian brand Morà Busoli, is an acronym for “Marmo Ossimorico Resistente Alleggerito” (Oxymoric Marble Resistant Lightened): a frame carved out of solid marble (and precious stones) and enriched by a carbon fiber armor. Morà Busoli represents the most exclusive products in its field that until now were simply impossible to manufacture. The producing factory, a precision engineering company called “BBG group”, is historically specialized in the R&D, prototyping and production applied to several high-tech fields such as biomedical, microsurgical, aerospace and racing. It is thanks to the application of such advanced technology that it is now possible to sculpt a frame off of a solid marble block, starting from 2 cms and going down to 0.8mm, creating what they love to call “a marble skin” and a frame with a starting weight of barely 38grams (Cult collection) or even 26 grams (Hoet for Morà collection).  Morà Busoli does not create frames out of a thin sheet of stone - rather, they're real and properly cut-stone sculptures. Each frame is a unique object, created through 18 full days of work and 193 phases of production.     If this “marble skin" embodies a charm that is unprecedented in the history of eyewear, the soul of Morà Busoli glasses is the “armour” of carbon fibre that covers their entire surface. It is thanks to this that Morà Busoli is the only brand that can guarantee both an unimaginable lightness and an absolute resistance to being dropped and to other shocks.

The high level of interest for the AP series results from the flexible powder distribution. This allows the powder application to be flexibly adapted to a wide variety of glass widths. Since the subject of quality is coming more and more into focus, electrostatics play an important role, Grafotec also supports its customers with questions and problems relating to this topic. Quality support is also provided with an automatic control of the release agent application by means of optical monitoring and the automatic correction of the powder application. Grafotec's aim is to respond to requests in order to provide each customer with a suitable system tailored to their needs and circumstances.

HQ Location: Germany, Lower Saxony, Ronnenberg, 5c Am Pütt, 30952
Company description: Our almost 40-year Seis Akustik history began in 1980 with the foundation in Hanover. Uwe Sonntag and Bernd Seidel established Seis Akustik as a specialist provider of acoustic sound reinforcement systems in reverberant spaces such as churches and halls. We quickly realized that standard loudspeaker systems are unsuitable for sound reinforcement in acoustically difficult rooms. Therefore, we developed unique special systems for our customers. With our application-oriented developments of microphones, mixing amplifiers and loudspeaker systems, we were able to quickly generate enthusiasm over the years. As early as 1995, we entered the digital age and developed the first digitally controlled audio system with the highest DSP audio quality in-house. Behind our user-friendly front panel, there were now plenty of digital functions and automatic control options. We pushed the limits of what is technically possible. High-tech products from Seis Akustik and our customer proximity are now appreciated in over 7,000 installations. Our sales area covers the whole of Germany and the European Community with decentralized service locations. In addition to sound reinforcement technology, we positioned the Seis Akustik media division in 1998 to deal specifically with large screen display, control technology and stage technology in all conference and training rooms. With our areas of software and hardware production as well as installation and support, we stand as a system house for innovative technology and customized concepts. The high competence and quality of the Seis Akustik team was successfully passed on to the next generation in 2015. Thomas Hauptstock and Rainer Krause took over the management as long-time employees.

Company description: In Tonet & Galvani ci occupiamo di lavorazioni su occhiali in acetato da oltre 40 anni. La nostra attenzione è rivolta al settori farmaceutico, chimico, cosmetico, biotecnologico, industria alimentare, ospedaliero, centri ricerca e laboratori ma anche al mondo microelettronico, delle nanotecnologie, aerospaziale, ottico e comunque a tutti gli ambienti che necessitano di elevati standard qualitativi. Name: Q-Tech Srl
Company description: Q-Tech srl (www.q-tech.it) è stata fondata nel 2002 , ed è specializzata nella progettazione e nello sviluppo di sensori ottici e sistemi basati su moderne tecniche di misurazione di sistemi optoelettronici. Dal 2013 Q-Tech è membro del gruppo OptoTech (http://www.opto-tech.it/) che riunisce quattro società distinte del settore dell'optoelettronica: OpenTechnologies ,Q-Tech ,T-Led ,Opto3. L'intero gruppo si trova a Rezzato (BS) e conta su uno staff altamente qualificato di circa 40 persone , quasi tutti giovani ingegneri laureati presso l'Università di Brescia, con un fatturato totale annuo di circa 4M € . Noi della Q-Tech ci occupiamo di sistemi di misura per il settore industriale e abbiamo sviluppato sistemi di controllo dimensionale non distruttivo  pensati per il controllo dimensionale e di difetti in linea e fuori linea per barre, putrelle, ogive, lamiere, profilati ed estrusi. Ad esempio sistemi per il controllo dimensionale del profilo di putrelle di acciaio per la determinazione delle quote di lavorazione in prossimità della torcia di taglio. Sistemi per controllo difetti in linea per barre tonte ed esagonali ReLine3D e riusciamo a selezionare le barre 'buone' da quelle 'difettose' direttamente in linea consentendo un maggior controllo qualità del prodotto finito, una maggiore tracciabilità del processo ed anche una ottimizzazione degli scarti e dei costi. Sistemi di controllo dimensionale in linea per processi a caldo, tra cui analisi billette e controllo dimensionale delle ogive. L’utilizzo del sistema ReCasting ha permesso lo sviluppo di un sistema di controllo in linea in grado di verificare dimensioni, ovalità e freccia del prodotto in lavorazione. Anche nel settore alimentare abbiamo realizzato sistemi in linea,ad esempio rilievo del profilo tridimensionale di forme arbitrarie di formaggio e determinazione in tempo reale della densità volumetrica angolare, ottenendo lo sviluppo di un sistema di ottimizzazione del taglio di forme in spicchi.

Company description: “Formelli 1945” è la nostra esperienza di azienda distributiva italiana nata nel 1945 grazie allo spirito imprenditoriale del nonno e proseguita con i nostri genitori, fino all’arrivo della terza generazione negli anni ’90. Nel corso di 70 anni abbiamo lavorato con grandi aziende produttrici, da Indo a Logo, e grandi marchi, da TAG Heuer a Vuarnet, da Harry Potter a Winnie the Pooh. Soprattutto lavoriamo con i più grandi ottici italiani e continuiamo ad essere ciò che siamo sempre stati: imprenditori di noi stessi in una piccola  struttura che ci piace definire un agile vascello, con la passione per il mare che ispira tutti noi. Il nostro obiettivo è portare agli ottici che cercano un’alternativa, prodotti ad alto contenuto tecnologico, andandoli a selezionare nelle nicchie della produzione mondiale. Formelli 1945 ripartirà da 3 prodotti: Flair, Magnys e Tabata. E presto ci saranno novità. Flair è una storica azienda tedesca nata settant’anni fa nella Germania della ricostruzione. Un’azienda che ci somiglia per la proprietà e la gestione familiare, oggi distribuita in oltre 50 Paesi del mondo con 120 dipendenti nella sede di Oelde.  Molto più recente è Magnys, nomination al Silmo d’Or per l’ambita categoria “Innovazione e Tecnologia”. Merito di un occhiale che permette all’ottico di far pesare la sua professionalità nell’ambito degli occhiali pronti da usare, grazie alla possibilità di montare il prodotto sulla reale distanza interpupillare del cliente e di dare una lente “office” dal disegno esclusivo.  Continua poi, nel solco di una tradizione lunga oltre 15 anni, il rapporto distributivo con la giapponese Tabata, leader degli occhialini da nuoto graduabili di alta qualità.  Insomma una sfida rinnovata, con nuovi marchi ma anche l’orgoglio di un “ritorno a casa” che ci stimola a ripartire dando il nostro meglio, sempre con un sorriso!

Name: POC
Company description: POC is a Swedish company dedicated to enhancing safety and performance for cyclists and athletes through innovative design and technology. Name: Sehen!wutscher

Name: Ottica Ing. Benedetto
HQ Location: Italy, Piedmont, Settimo Torinese, 27 Via Italia, 10036
Company description: Il punto di incontro nel centro di Settimo. Le origini dell’Ottica ing. Benedetto sono da ricercarsi nel lontano 1928 quando Mario Benedetto aprì a Settimo Torinese  L’ Oreficeria Orologeria Mario Benedetto. In quel tempo spesso si univa all’ attività di oreficeria la vendita di occhiali da vista; successivamente si manifestò la necessità di aumentare la professionalità nel  settore ottico al fine di adeguarsi alle normative e il Cav. Mario fece frequentare il corso di ottica ai suoi due figli.  La svolta alla fine degli anni 70 quando l’Ing. Carlo decise di interrompere l’esperienza industriale in un clima infuocato dovuto agli anni di piombo e di riprendere in mano il suo diploma di ottico. Nel 1980 nasce Ottica Ing .Benedetto Carlo in una nuova location a Settimo Torinese. L’Ing. Carlo è affiancato nell’attività dalla moglie Olga e dalla giovanissima figlia Elena, la sua proverbiale precisione diventa la caratteristica che contraddistinguerà l’attività negli anni a venire. All’Ing. Carlo e la Signora Olga subentra la figlia Elena ormai Ottico da molti anni, e con una laurea in Ortottica, e ad affiancarla troviamo il marito Giancarlo Amberti, laureato in Economia e commercio, che decide di rimettersi in gioco con una nuova avventura e si diploma in ottica, e si specializza in Optometria per entrare a pieno titolo nella gestione dell’attività. In quegli anni l’Ottica Ing. Benedetto cresce ancora si affiancano ai due titolari altri due ottici diplomati un tecnico di laboratorio ed una collaboratrice. Nel 2008 l’attività si trasferisce nei locali dove 80 anni prima era nata l’oreficeria, acquisendo nuovi spazi, ed arrivando a occupare una superficie di oltre 200 metri quadri. Oggi può disporre di un ampio salone di vendita, uno splendido show room, e un intero piano di laboratori attrezzati delle migliori attrezzature per l’ipovisione la contattologia specialistica e l’ortottica e un modernissimo laboratorio interno di montaggio.

Name: Univet Optical Technologies

Through its dedication to accessibility and community engagement, GrandVision Italy envisions a world where everyone can see better and live better.

Name: Disop
Company description: Here at Disop, we have been developing formulas and manufacturing eye care and contact lenses care products for many years. Our journey began in the 1970s when the company’s founder, Javier Chamorro Tormo, travelled to England to learn about an invention that at the time seemed a thing of science fiction. This groundbreaking concept was a special lens that could be placed inside the eye to improve the wearer’s eyesight – what we now know as contact lenses. Javier came back to Spain thrilled by this revolutionary idea and set out to visit optician after optician explaining the advantages it would bring and its potential to improve millions of lives. In the early years, the liquid required to keep those lenses in good condition had to be imported from abroad, making it costly and difficult to come by. This is what inspired Javier to set up his own liquid production factory: Disop. Javier’s son took over as manager in the 80s and the company grew to become a benchmark manufacturer on the Spanish eye care scene. Research by Disop Our laboratory develops new, innovative formulas for eye care and contact lenses care products. We work with state-of-the-art ingredients such as hyaluronic acid and have registered several patents. We recently added a new active agent to our catalogue -cannabidiol- , with which we have launched a new range of products and broadened our commercial activity to reach new markets. We also care about animal well-being, so we have developed a new pet product concept that is free from toxic substances, petrochemicals and fragrances. Manufacturing by Disop At our facilities in Alcobendas (Madrid), we produce our own brands in addition to manufacturing products for clients. Distribution by Disop As well as shipping across Spain, our products can be found in over 30 countries around the world.

Name: Syllucid
Company description: Syllucid is dedicated to producing fair, sustainable, and long-lasting electronic products. We started this company to give consumers responsible alternatives, to show the true cost of electronic products on the planet, and to work towards reforming our industry. We use our products as magnifying glasses on the electronics industry. By researching their supply chains they show us what challenges the industry is facing, what problems its supply chains cause, and how they can be solved.  We can’t change the industry alone or overnight, but we are steadily putting solutions into practice: Sustainable & fair materials We are dedicated to fairly and responsibly sourcing as many materials as possible and creating planet-centric supply chains for our products. This means using recycled and fairly sourced minerals and plastics and good working conditions along the entire supply chain. Durable Designs To make our and your products last as long as possible we're using innovative and durable design techniques to significantly prolong the lifespan of each product. The longer they last, the fewer we have to produce. Supply chain research and transparency We're using our products to make problems in electronics supply chains visible. We're using this knowledge to tackle systemic industry issues by creating partnerships with manufacturers, suppliers, customers, peers, NGOs, and governments. We partner up with researchers to find new ways how we can make value chains fairer and more sustainable. Creating holistically fair, sustainable and transparent supply chains will take a long time. But we think there is no time to waste. The sooner we start to address these problems, the better for all of us and our planet. That's why we're addressing this challenge head-on and are taking big steps forward with each batch we produce.

Name: Opticalrooms Ltd

Working within GP surgeries, along side the other health care professionals we make every effort to bring great expertise and value to the centre. Opticalrooms has a very low cost business model with none of the associated cost of renting and running a high street unit. We pass these savings on to our customers. In this way we can have a physical presence and compete with other online companies. I qualified as an Optometrist in 1990, a long time ago at this stage but rather than be entrenched in my ways I love change. The power of the internet has put this change in the hands of the public. The optical industry dreads the idea of people purchasing online or comparing prices. Personally I have no problem with this. We encourage people to purchase online and after they attend any of our clinics we upload their optical details, in full! to an online account where they have everything they need to order from us or anywhere on the web. Each clinic is fully stocked with frames, sunglasses and contact lenses and not every patient wants to transact online. Our goal is to provide great professional service, convenience and value. In the US and the UK, the O Scope has been introduced in recent years and is increasingly finding a place next to the operation microscope and magnifying glasses. The technology and unique production of implants combine the benefits of durable and imaging-compatible fiber-reinforced composites and the bone forming capability of bioactive glasses. As a result, medical implantology has shifted from metal-containing implants to novel high-tech composite implants of individual anatomic design and contour. GLACE™ – Good to the bone The active innovation and patenting policy resulted in the establishment of Skulle Implants. Globally, it is the only Class III (European Medical Device Regulation) medical device producing company that focuses on the production of unique custom-made bioactive glass fiber composite implants for bone repair and replacement. In 2014, the company launched its new production facilities in Turku and received accreditation for starting the production of custom-made implants. Skulle Implants aims to expand the clinical indications of GLACE™ platform technology in close collaboration with clinical experts and material scientists.

Name: Bonami SpelComputer Museum
Company description: At the Bonami Museum in Zwolle you will find the largest collection of game consoles and computers in the Netherlands. There are also a huge amount of games, collector items and merchandise products to admire. Did you already know that you can not only wath our item but also play with them? A large part of both the old and new game consoles are playable. As many as 250 people can use it simultaneously. And of course not to forget our impressive arcade hall, with a large collection of retro arcade cabinets, all freely playable for the public. Museum visitors can also experience an unforgettable 3D experience with the Oculus Rift 3D glasses or the Sony PS4 Pro and PS VR headset. Even a working 3D printer is not missing from the collection. The 3000m2 exhibition space offers us the opportunity to choose a wonderfully spacious setup. This gives the visitor the space and freedom to fully enjoy the unique museum. Apart from the entrance fee, no costs are charged for playing on the consoles and arcade cabinets. Come and experience it! It is an educational, but above all fun and interactive outing for all ages.

Name: Mosede Fort Danmark 1914-18
Company description: Mosede Fort, Denmark 1914-18 is organisationally part of Greve Museum, which is a nationally recognized municipal museum of cultural history The exhibition is for adults as well as families with children. You do not have to put on your reading glasses. Use your ears, eyes and hands to learn about an important yet forgotten period of Danish history. A period that changed the lives of the Danes forever.  The exhibition has distinct interactive elements that require your active involvement.

Name: Museo Del PRECINEMA - Collezione Minici Zotti
HQ Location: Italy, Veneto, Padova, 1 A Prato Della Valle, 35123
Company description: Housed in the 15th century Palazzo Angeli in Padova’s Prato della Valle, the Museo del Precinema displays the private collection of director Laura Minici Zotti: projection glasses, magic lanterns, hand paintings of the 18th and 19th century, optical games, antique cameras and other instruments that trace the history of the pre-cinema era. One of Padua’s most original museums, the fascinating world of visual reproduction from the 18th century up to the birth of modern cinema.

Name: Museo D'Arte E Scienza Srl
HQ Location: Italy, Lombardy, Milan, 4 Via Quintino Sella, 20121
Company description: The itinerary on determining the authenticity of art and antiques is the feather in the Museum’s cap,  the only example in the world of a museum dedicated to the important question of determining the authenticity of art. Each room deals with a basic theme, from painting on canvas and wood to excavated pottery, antique furniture, amber and ivory. The itinerary culminates in the splendid tapestry room, where visitors can admire rugs and tapestries of different crafting techniques and provenances, and learn to recognize the characteristics of authenticity. The section is also equipped with test stations with microscopes and magnifying glasses. There is also a special itinerary designed for kids. In 2010, twenty years after its foundation, the Museum finally succeeded in giving the deserved space and importance to the Buddhist Art collection. A careful selection was made from among the numerous and remarkable items from Thailand, Burma, China and Japan to form the permanent exhibition entitled “East Asian Buddhist Art”, considered one of the finest Italian collections of Indochinese art. Exhibition: “Leonardo Citizen of Milan” In 1483 Leonardo presented himself to the Duke of Milan, offering his services as an expert in military and industrial machines, engineer of navigable canals, painter, architect, sculptor and master of revels. This promise obliged him, during his twenty years at court, to undertake intense activity and exploit all his talent.

Name: Thorvaldsens Museum
Company description: Thorvaldsens Museum is a gem in the heart of Copenhagen. Presenting the collection of the world-famous Danish sculptor Bertel Thorvaldsen (1770-1844) we aim to enhance everybody's enjoyment and understanding of sculptural and neoclassic art pieces and also to encourage viewing these through modern glasses. Since opening in 1848 as the first museum building in Denmark the museum has afforded visitors a very special opportunity to savour world-class architecture and neoclassic art. The museum was built with the specific purpose of housing all the works by Thorvaldsen and also his extensive collections of contemporary art of his time. A tour of the museum reveals a series of very colourful galleries in each of which stands one or few sculptures. These sculptures represent Roman gods as well as famous historical personages, and are characterized by exceptional charisma. With vibrant colours and magnificent architectural design, the powerful atmosphere of the museum building itself creates a fascinating contrast to the white sculptures, which come to stand out in a very distinct way.

Name: Stiftung Deutsches Optisches Museum
Company description: Die gemeinnützige private Stiftung Deutsches Optisches Museum (D.O.M.) entwickelt, errichtet und betreibt das D.O.M. als Leitmuseum der Optik und Photonik. Sie wird getragen von der Carl Zeiss AG, der Friedrich-Schiller-Universität Jena, der Carl-Zeiss-Stiftung, der Ernst-Abbe-Stiftung sowie der Stadt Jena. Seit Mitte 2022 unterstützt zudem die Jenoptik AG den Betrieb des Museums.   Das D.O.M. verwahrt Technisches Kulturgut aus über 500 Jahren Optikgeschichte, darunter mehrere hundert Mikroskope, die bedeutendsten Brillensammlungen und das mit 100.000 Proben größte Glasarchiv der Welt.  Die interaktive Dauerausstellung eröffnen wir mit gut 100 interaktive Stationen im zweiten Halbjahr 2027. Als Alleinstellungsmerkmal des D.O.M. dürfen die Besuchenden auf 3.100 m² die physikalischen Phänomene der Optik an dutzenden historischen optischen Instrumenten selbst begreifen. So wird Optik und Photonik erlebbar und mit der Lebenswirklichkeit verbunden. Das Gebäude des D.O.M. erstreckt sich über die denkmalgeschützte erste staatliche Optikerschule und einen künstlerisch gestalteten Neubau, dessen Fassade das Spiel mit optischen Phänomenen bereits im Außenraum auf faszinierende Weise genießen lässt.  Während der Baumaßnahmen bleiben die umfangreichen Sammlungen für die Forschung zugänglich, zudem fungiert das D.O.M. als aktiver internationaler Leihgeber.

Company description: KAS IR DATORBRILLES? Mūsdienās mēs visi strādājam un mācāmies pie datora. Visi šie ekrāni izstaro zilo gaismu, kas pie ilgstošas noslodzes var radīt diskomfortu acīm un labsajūtai. Ja arī tev dienas beigās acis ir nogurušas un sausas, tad Blinkely datorbrilles būs lielisks palīgs tavā ikdienā! Datorbrilles ir piemērotas cilvēkiem, kam sanāk ikdienā daudz laika pavadīt pie datora vai citiem digitālajiem ekrāniem. ĻOTI VIENKĀRŠI Lai iegādātos datorbrilles, nav nepieciešamas ārstu izziņas, pārbaudes vai receptes, jo datorbrillēs esošās lēcas nepalīdz redzes problēmām, bet gan, lai pasargātu mūsu acis no datoru un citu ekrānu radītās “zilās gaismas” un mēs izvairītos no acu diskomforta. KAS IR ZILĀ GAISMA? Zilā gaisma ir krāsa redzamās gaismas spektrā (380nm un 500nm), ko var saskatīt cilvēka acs. Zilajai gaismai ir īss viļņu garums, kas nozīmē, ka tā rada lielāku enerģijas daudzumu un līdz ar to lielāku spiedienu uz mūsu acīm. Zilo gaismu mēs redzam, izmantojot digitālos ekrānus (zilo gaismu var atrast televizoros, viedtālruņos, datoros, klēpjdatoros, planšetdatoros un spēļu konsolēs). Pētījumi liecina, ka ilgstoša zilās gaismas iedarbība var izraisīt acu un labsajūtas diksomfortu – acu nogurumu, sausumu, sasprindzinājumu, vispārēju nogurumu, galvassāpes un bezmiegu. KĀPĒC VAJAG DATORBRILLES? Mūsdienās praktiski dzīvojam pie ekrāniem, pavadot vidēji astoņas stundas dienā digitālo ierīču priekšā. Visas šīs ierīces izstaro zilo gaismu, un, tā kā mūsu acis nav aizsargātas pret šo pārmērīgo iedarbību, zilā gaisma var radīt diskomfortu acīm. Iespējamās blakusparādības ir: - Acu nogurums, sausums; - Galvassāpes; - Vispārējs nogurums un miega problēmas; PRIEKŠROCĪBAS Uzlabojot gan miega kvalitāti, gan koncentrēšanās spējas, “Blinkely” brilles būs manāms palīgs Jūsu ikdienā: - Mazina acu nogurumu un pārpūli; - Samazina vispārēju nogurumu un miegainību; - Uzlabo miega kvalitāti; - Aizsargaā pret zilo gaismu un UV starojumu; - Uzlabo koncentrēšanās spējas un produktivitāti.

Name: Mosaics By Margarita Theodorakis
Company description: Margarita-Aspasia Theodorakis is the daughter of Mikis Theodorakis and Mirto Altinoglou. She was born in Paris on 30 November 1958. She studied history at the University of Paris VIII, Sorbonne, and is a mother of four. For the past 17 years she has devoted herself to the work of Mikis Theodorakis. She is in charge of the ‘Mikis Theodorakis’ Popular Orchestra, whose goal is to make the composer’s music known in Greece and abroad. She is also involved with the ‘Romanos’ publications, which aims at publishing and promoting her father’s Complete Works. For years now, in her free time, she used to do embroidery, and later on she started collecting broken objects (tiles, glasses, plates, ornaments etc), which she assembles on walls. She started out by working on small surfaces and over the past years she has expanded her collages to cover entire external walls and floors. Margarita Theodorakis is self-taught; she has never received any special training and has learned her craft through trial and error. She has been influenced by the different cultures she came across during her travels around the world, but mainly by Greek landscapes and colours. Her creations mix porcelain, metal, pearls, mirrors, tiles, various ceramics, as well as other objects, such as two old bicycles. She started out by studying various materials and how they could be put together, and subsequently she learned the technique through practice. As she explained herself “I needed to express myself artistically, and by exploring the art of mosaics, I felt right at home" (see the full interview here). She has a very distinctive artistic style. She never does the same thing twice and all her designs are unique. She accepts custom orders, but she reserves a large degree of freedom in relation to her creations.

Kolejnym i głównym celem naszej pracy jest doradztwo i pomoc przy wyborze odpowiednich opraw do okularów korekcyjnych i przeciwsłonecznych. Do danes je poslovalnico Optike Clarus BTC City Ljubljana obiskalo že preko milijon (!) obiskovalcev, iz leta v leto pa narašča tudi število zvestih strank, ki prisegajo na kakovost storitev in obsežno ponudbo vrhunskih očal ter drugih optičnih pripomočkov. V letu 2017 smo zasnovali povsem nov koncept izkušnje okulističnih pregledov in nakupa očal, ki v ospredje postavlja strankino dobro počutje, temu pa prilagodili tudi interier. S sedežnimi garniturami in prijetnim ambientom, ki spominja na domačo dnevno sobo, želimo strankam vzbuditi občutek domačnosti, predvsem pa jim omogočiti, da je celoten proces - od okulističnega pregleda pri specialistu, preko strokovnega svetovanja vrhunskih prodajalcev - optikov, pa do nakupa očal - čim bolj udoben. I nostri centri sono stati tra i primi in Italia ad occuparsi di contattologia e questa lunga tradizione nel campo della applicazione delle lenti a contatto ha generato grande esperienza e professionalità. Il personale dell’ottica è composto da ottici, ottici optometristi ed ortottisti che vi accompagneranno nella scelta del prodotto migliore per soddisfare le vostre esigenze mettendo sempre al primo posto la qualità. Il continuo aggiornamento professionale e la ricerca di nuove tecnologie nel campo dell’ottica e della contattologia ci permette di fornire soluzioni adeguate e personalizzate in grado di soddisfare ogni richiesta. Met name eerste gebruikers zijn vaak op zoek naar discrete oplossingen. Lyric is zo comfortabel dat je niet merkt dat je een hoortoestel draagt.                                                                                                        Op het gebied van preventie zal All Ears Hoorzorg zich ook meer gaan toeleggen op het aanmeten van gehoorbescherming ten behoeve van de industrie en particulieren. Tinnitus krijgt ook de volle aandacht. Hierbij zullen we uitgaan van hoortoestellen in combinatie met een advies voor multidisciplinaire aanpak in combinatie met therapieën om hiermee de patiënt zo optimaal mogelijk te kunnen begeleiden in het revalidatieproces. Ottica De Marco apre i battenti il primo Febbraio 2007 grazie a  Massimo, il titolare, appassionato di nuoto, instancabile costruttore di sogni, dal suo cognome prende il nome l'ottica.  In che cosa crediamo?  Crediamo in uno stile di vita sano ed equilibrato, che non coinvolga solo gli occhi ma tutto il corpo nella ricerca di una completa armonia.  Crediamo nella famiglia e nell'interesse sincero verso gli altri, nella condivisione, nell'accoglienza, nell'amore, non un modo di dire ma un sentimento fatto di gesti, a volte piccoli, ma che possono cambiare le cose. Crediamo in un modello di lavoro sostenibile che rispetti le persone, in un clima in cui, nel totale rispetto e nell'aiuto reciproco, si tenda al miglioramento costante. E proprio in quest'ottica, abbiamo una grande responsabilità: quella di insegnare ai nostri figli a essere migliori di noi. Possiamo iniziare a farlo, promuovendo i valori in cui noi stessi prima di tutto crediamo. Queste sono le basi da cui partiamo per svolgere al meglio il nostro mestiere e vivere con coerenza la nostra vita. Per saperne di  più: http://www.otticademarco.it/chi-siamo.php

Name: Milanottica Srl
Company description: Milanottica nasce a Castelfranco Veneto nel febbraio del 1979 dall’innamoramento di Guerrino della nostra città murata sotto la pioggia. Guerrino già fotografo ed ottico diplomato con uno studio a Milano dove abitava, tornando da un matrimonio a San Martino di Lupari, si trovo a passare per Castelfranco Veneto, mentre era sotto l’acquazzone scocca la magia di questa città. Guerrino si innamorò della città murata e decise che questa sarebbe stata la sede avrebbe voluto cominciare una nuova ventura lavorativa. Tre mesi dopo l’incontro magico con la città lascio lo studio di Milano e le testate giornalistiche per cui lavorava come fotografo e si trasferiva Castelfranco Veneto, nella prima sedi, in via Montegrappa, con il nome di “Milanottica” (Svelato quindi non ridere il nome Milanottica). Quando qualche anno più tardi conosce Paola con la quale instaura una relazione affettiva sfociata in un matrimonio dal quale sono poi nate due figlie. Guarino amava così tanto il suo lavoro da conteggiare anche Paola, tanto che nonostante due bimbe piccole, paola riprende gli studi conseguendo il diploma di ottico a Bergamo nel 1981. Paola, continua la sua attività formativa, nel 1984 segue un corso triennale a Milano conseguendo il diploma regionale (ora laurea in optometria); Negli anni seguenti Paola non smette mai di aggiornarsi, grazie al supporto della famiglia, con una formazione continua… Tanto che nell’anno 2011 il congresso nazionale di ottica, assegna alla signora Paola Girardi il PREMIO OPTOMETRISTA DELL’ANNO 2011 – “Distinguendosi per la particolare professionalità”. Tra le varie attività anche la prevenzione delle scuole per il progetto educazione della vista e bimbo visione tenendo numerose conferenze. Spinta dalla passione dei genitori anche una delle figlie ha seguito le orme dei genitori, e da qualche anno è entrata nell’attività di Milanottica. … Da oltre 40 anni la Milanottica da valore ai tuoi occhi… to be continued …

Name: Glasögonmäster
Company description: En del tycker att vi är lite galna. Själva kallar vi det passionerade. Hos oss tycker vi nämligen att det är så kul med glasögon och nöjda kunder, att vi lägger ner mer tid på vårt jobb och våra kunder än vad som kanske kan räknas som affärsmässigt sunt. Som tur är så är vi inte affärsanalytiker eller ekonomer, utan gäng engagerade optiker och assistenter med olika specialistkompetenser som drivs av glädje, lust och nyfikenhet. Därför går det bra i alla fall. Till och med så bra att vi under de senaste åren har blivit utsedda till Årets Butik av Svensk Handel inte mindre än två gånger – 2009 och 2014. Senaste motiveringen är vi extra stolta över: “När man synar denna gedigna verksamhet blir det påtagligt att ingenting lämnas åt slumpen. Täta samarbeten skapas för att kunna erbjuda kunderna det allra senaste inom denna bransch där det ställs stora krav på hög kompetens. Framgången skapas med hjälp av mottot: Kompetens-Kvalitet-Trygghet och 120 % service.” Vad de egentligen skriver är: Vi älskar glasögon och det vi gör! Bättre grund kan man inte ha. Vi strävar inte efter att bli störst, inte heller att vara billigast. Men målsättningen att vara bäst för dig som kund tullar vi inte en endaste millimeter på.

Das wiederum bringt viele Nachteile mit sich, wie z.b. Kopfschmerzen, Unkonzentriertheiten oder ein erhöhtes Unfall- und Sturzrisiko im Straßenverkehr. Der normale Wiederbeschaffungsrhythmus von Brillen (ca. alle drei Jahre) ist aus unserer Sicht viel zu lang, was sicherlich auch an den hohen Kosten für eine neue Brille liegt. Durch die preiswerte Alternative von Eyeglass24 zum Brillenkauf können sich Menschen mit einer Sehschwäche jederzeit eine optimale Sehhilfe leisten: Exakt auf ihre aktuelle Sehstärke optimiert und in der gleichen Qualität wie beim Optiker. Name: Juwelier Optiek Verlinden
Company description: Juwelier Verlinden bestaat al sinds 1936. In dat jaar begon Piet Verlinden als gediplomeerd uurwerkmaker in de boerderij waar hij woonde horloges te repareren. Op dat adres aan de Pastoor Jacobsstraat ontstond een bedrijf dat snel uitgroeide en samen met een vijftal medewerkers de oorlogsjaren overleefde. Na de oorlog werd er een nieuw pand gebouwd in het centrum van Sint Hubert. De winkel is daar nog steeds gevestigd. Door het plotseling overlijden van de oprichter werd het bedrijf overgenomen door zijn broer Wim Verlinden die een boerenbedrijf had in de Noordoostpolder. De jaren daarna werd het bedrijf veelvuldig gemoderniseerd en regelmatig verbouwd om met de tijd mee te gaan. Eind tachtiger jaren is het regionaal bekendstaande bedrijf overgegaan in handen van diens zoon Geer die er samen met zijn vrouw Marianne een modern juwelier optiek bedrijf van hebben gemaakt. In de tijd dat wij als Juwelier Optiek Verlinden bestaan, hebben we veel ervaring opgedaan, veranderingen ondergaan en binding gekregen met veel van onze klanten. In al die jaren staat een tevreden klant bij ons hoog in het vaandel. Dat is altijd zo geweest. Sieraden zijn bijzonder om te kopen of te krijgen, het is vaak een mooie herinnering. Horloges zijn een mooi stukje techniek en tegelijkertijd een sieraad. Op onze optiekafdeling adviseren wij over de vele mogelijkheden van lenzen en brillen. Zowel in de optiek als in de juwelier zijn onze medewerkers deskundig opgeleid. Zo zorgen wij ervoor dat onze deskundigheid gewaarborgd blijft.

In questi anni abbiamo affinato le conoscenze scientifiche studiando e testando strumenti di ultimissima generazione che la tecnologia ha offerto. Nel 2013 si apre un nuovo store a Barletta in una sede importante per la città. Il reparto “contattologia” è a disposizione per far conoscere il corretto uso, manutenzione e potenzialità delle lenti a contatto di ogni tipo. Il nostro impegno sostiene anche il sociale: collaborando con Luxottica diamo vita ad iniziative benefiche di raccolta occhiali quali “One Sight”. Possiamo concludere affermando che in questi anni abbiamo seguito un solo obiettivo: “curare i vostri occhi”.

Name: DIJCK2
HQ Location: Netherlands, South Holland, Delft, 2 Oude Langendijk, 2611 gk
Company description: DIJCK2 is een bijzondere brillenwinkel in Delft, waar je gemakkelijk binnenloopt en gezellig monturen en zonnebrillen kunt passen.  DE WERELD ZIEN Bij DIJCK2 gaat het er niet alleen om hoe je ziet of hoe je eruit ziet, maar vooral om hoe jìj de wereld ziet. Er is zoveel te ontdekken, te zien en te beleven. Waar richt jij je vizier op? Wat wordt jouw volgende avontuur? Wij moedigen je aan je dromen na te jagen. Van de momenten te genieten, en onderweg nieuwe vrienden te maken. We hebben oog voor de wereld en zijn nieuwsgierig naar het verhaal achter de bril. De oorsprong ervan en dat hij op een eerlijke manier wordt gemaakt. We bieden stijlvolle brillen die onderstrepen hoe jij naar de wereld kijkt. Laat ons zien wie je bent, we kijken graag met je mee. FASHION Onze monturen zijn met liefde en vakmanschap gemaakt. Future classics met een sterke gevoelswaarde. Ingetogen ontwerpen met karakter, monturen en zonnebrillen waar je blij van wordt. EST. 1968 Er zijn zoveel mooie brillenmerken dat we ze in één winkel gewoon niet kwijt kunnen. Dus toen de kans zich voordeed DIJCK2 te openen, hebben we die onmiddellijk met beide handen aangegrepen. We wisten ook precies wat we wilden. Een gezellige winkel waar je gemakkelijk naar binnen loopt en zonder verplichting monturen en zonnebrillen kunt passen. Zulke winkels zien we bijvoorbeeld in New York maar zijn hier nog dun gezaaid. Bij DIJCK2 verkopen we mooie Amerikaanse merken zoals DITA, Oliver Peoples, Garrett Leight en Moscot maar ook het puur Amsterdamse Dick Moby, dat duurzame en verantwoord geproduceerde (zonne)brillen maakt, en het kersverse Nina & Max. NAAM Misschien wist je al dat we onze naam hebben te danken aan onze karakteristieke, eeuwenoude straat. We zijn gevestigd op de Oude Langendijk, nummer 2. Name: Fielmann Ventures GmbH
Company description: Fielmann Ventures is at the heart of Fielmann’s vision to digitise the eyewear industry to the benefit of consumers without compromising quality. Whereas the Fielmann Group employs hundreds of specialists working in an agile product organisation, Fielmann Ventures focuses on the disruptive technologies that will revolutionise the eyewear industry. We focuse on the industry’s unique position at the intersection of retail, fashion and healthcare to develop the leading platform for the eyewear industry available for customers, healthcare professionals and suppliers. Digitisation has fundamentally altered traditional market rules. Exclusivity and control give way to partnerships and networks. Fielmann Venture’s focus on the eyewear industry allows us to integrate often-separated entities into one holistic unit. With a team of 20 specialists with expertise in computer science, optical physics, mathematics, strategy, business development and finance, we serve our industry as venture capitalist, incubator, accelerator, strategic partner and research unit. It is our firm belief that mutually beneficial partnerships will create a network that will bring about the leading platform for the eyewear industry.

Name: Kluin Opticiens
Company description: In 1862 heeft Derk Kluin zich gevestigd in Meppel aan de oude Haagenstraat. Als goud en zilversmid maakte hij brillen in opdracht van de klant. Für Iffland als Firma mit langer Geschichte ist die Verbindung von Tradition und Innovation schon immer ein wichtiger Erfolgsfaktor gewesen. Eigene Arbeitskreise für Anpassung, Technik, Ausbildung und Hörtraining treiben die dynamische Entwicklung des Unternehmens fortwährend voran. Um das mittlerweile komplexe Leistungsangebot in allen Bereichen rund ums Thema Hören auch nach außen spürbar zu machen, wurde „Hörgeräte Iffland“ 2008 in „iffland.hören“ umbenannt. In manufacturing, the frames go through a delicate process that require more than 100 steps. All frames go through a quality check at the factory before they are ready to be sold. The materials we use to manufacture our frames are sourced from several countries, but mainly we use materials from Italy, Germany, and China. Design All of our frames are designed at our office in Oslo, Norway. When designing our frames our focus is on making classic frames with clean details that will be just as stylish in ten years as today. Functionality is very important to us. The frames should sit well and be comfortable. After all it’s a product you often use daily.

Forgalmazott eszközeink segítségével kialakítható a legegyszerűbb otthoni 4 kamerás rendszer távoli hálózati eléréssel, valamint a több száz kamerát tartalmazó – jellemzően strukturált vezetékes és vezeték nélküli hálózatban elhelyezett – nagyrendszerek is. Vállalunk egyedi igényeknek megfelelő (rendszám, arcfelismerő, hőkamera, közúti közlekedés megfigyelő, térfigyelő, egészségügyi, mezőgazdasági, halászati célú) rendszertervezést és kialakítást is. Szükség esetén megszervezzük a telepített rendszer hálózati alkalmazásainak (CMS, Android, iPhone, Smart TV, stb.) telepítését, konfigurációját. A rendszerek gyakran olyan helyszínen kerülnek beépítésre, ahol nincs erősáramú szolgáltatás, forrás. Ilyen esetekben szigetüzemű napkollektoros rendszereket szoktunk javasolni, tervezni és a kivitelezésben segíteni. Behatolásjelző, beléptető infravörös sorompó és kerítésvédelmi rendszerek A klasszikusnak számító behatolásjelző (egyszerűbben: riasztó) rendszerek tervezése és kivitelezése ma már viszonylag egyszerű feladatnak számít, igaz az informatika fejlődésének köszönhetően már ezek az eszközök is GSM / IP hálózatra csatlakoztathatók, bővítve ezzel a lehetőségeket akár vezetéske, vagy vezeték nélküli kivitelben. Tervezéskor (a költségek figyelembe vételével) adott feltételek mellett a lehető legnagyobb biztonságot adó rendszerek ajánlata mellett szoktunk dönteni. A behatolásjelzők mellett nagyobb irodaépületek kialakításakor szükség lehet beléptető rendszer kialakítására is. Programozása és konfigurálása hasonló a riasztó rendszerekéhez, hálózati kialakításban ma már előnyben részesítik a LAN struktúrát az RS-485 hálózattal szemben. Utóbbinak relatív kis rendszereknél van létjogosultsága. Infravörös sorompóval ellátott, esetleg elektromos kerítésvédelem kialakítására leginkább nagy kiterjedésű telephelyeken (mezőgazdaság) van szükség, ahol elsősorban költségkímélő megoldásként gondolnak rájuk. Elektromos kerítésvédelem tervezése és kialakítása már komolyabb felkészültséget igényel. A rendszer összetevők általában: csatlakozó kábel, jelfeldolgozó egység, illesztő egység, érzékelő elem és lezáró egység. Működési elve: A jelfeldolgozó egység észleli az érzékelőn (kábelen) kialakult töltésváltozást, amely az érzékelőn (kábelen) keletkezik. A töltésváltozást a védett kerítés elemen / szakaszon történt mechanikai hatások (elvágták a kábelt, kerítésdarabot, mechanikai sérülés) okozzák. Informatikai és épületfelügyeleti strukturált hálózat Ma már bármely biztonságtechnikai rendszer önálló és internet hálózattól függetlenített telepítése nagyon ritka. Ez a tény megköveteli, hogy a rendszerek telepítésénél figyelembe vegyük a szükséges informatikai hálózat kialakítását is. A legegyszerűbb esetben a hálózatot újonnan kell kialakítani. Ilyen esetben tervezéskor a költséghelyek figyelembe vételével mindig igyekszünk „túltervezni” az adott hálózatot. Már meglévő rendszer esetén az érintett hálózat fenntartó szakembereivel történő egyeztetés után kerül a hálózat megtervezésre, majd kialakításra. Technológiai szempontból általában vegyes hálózatokat szoktunk kialakítani. Amennyiben a költségvetés lehetővé teszi, akkor igyekszünk optikai (mono- és/vagy multimódusú) hálózat (legalább a nagytávolságú gerinchálózat) kialakítására a megfelelő végberendezések illesztésével (média konverter, ONT, stb.) Az épület nagyságától, valamint az igényelt funkcióktól függően gyakran több egymással összefüggő hálózati szegmenseket ajánlunk a megfelelő mennyiségű vezetékes és RF végpontokkal (rack szekrények, rack szerelvények, switch, ap, home gateway, hot-spot, szektorantennák, stb.), illetve nagyobb földrajzi távolságok esetén VLAN struktúrákkal. A hálózatban elhelyezett aktív eszközök programozását, szoftverek, firmwarek telepítését, konfigurálását partnereink végzik, melyben igény esetén szakmai segítséget nyújtunk. Épülethangosítási rendszerek Rendszertechnikai szempontból egyszerű összetevőkből áll, általában mennyezeti és oldalfali sounderekből, erősítő egységből, mikrofon és FM tuner modulból. Elsősorban az MT rézvezetékkel fizikailag összekötött hálózati kialakítást részesítjük előnyben, ezért RF technológiát csak külön kérés esetén alkalmazunk. Tervezése és kivitelezése is rendkívül egyszerű feladat. Kaputechnika Általában nem igényelnek komolyabb tervezést, elegendő a telepítési helyszín szemrevételezése, méretek, arányok rögzítése és teljesítmény kalkuláció. Toló-, szárnyas-kapu, valamint szekcionált garázskapu mozgató berendezések telepítésében tudunk szakmai tanácsot adni, nagyobb rendszerek, ipari kapuk esetén helyszíni segítséget nyújtani elsősorban a vezérlések bekötéséhez, programozáshoz. Okos házak Termék portfóliónk részeként – a kor igényeihez igazodva – úgynevezett „okosház” funkciók kialakításához is kínálunk közép- és prémium kategóriás műszaki megoldásokat. A rendszerhez szükséges eszközök komplex berendezések, az épületgépészeti elemeken kívül tartalmaznak vezérlő elektronikát és informatikai (elsősorban vezetékes és RF hálózati) összetevőket, ugyanakkor a moduláris felépítésnek köszönhetően a funkcióbővítés egyszerűen kivitelezhető. A termékcsoport egyaránt alkalmas régi (ez esetben nehezebb összetett rendszert tervezni) és újonnan létesült építményekbe történő telepítésre. Alaprendszerünk segítségével ablakok (redőny-, zsalugáter-, és függönymozgató motorok) és teraszajtók bel- és/vagy kültéri árnyékolásának automatizált, manuális vagy dátum/idő paraméterekkel ütemezett vezérlése valósítható meg. Igény szerint a vezérlés kiterjeszthető kültéri árnyékoló eszközökre is (napellenző, textilszalag, pergola), de természetesen önálló rendszerként is szerelhető (például: vendéglátóhelyek kültéri teraszai). A tisztán mechanikai vezérlés mellé telepíthetők a már tényleges „okosház” megoldások, amelyek elsősorban kényelmi és biztonságtechnikai szolgáltatásokat biztosítanak, úgymint fűtésvezérlés rádiós termosztáttal, világításkapcsolás, vetítővászon motorok működtetése. Az épületbiztonság pedig riasztó, video-kaputelefon és önálló megfigyelő kamerák segítségével valósítható meg. „Okosház” megoldásunk bármely kombinációja könnyedén vezérelhető és paraméterezhető egy professzionális kliensoldali és mobil alkalmazás gyűjtemény segítségével.

Company description: Om Preislers Optiska Institut AB: Ett av Sveriges äldsta optikerföretag, Preislers Optiska Institut grundades redan 1902 och är sedan många år en välkänd institution på Stortorget i Malmö. Detta ger oss möjligheten att ha ett mycket stort urval, både vad gäller varumärken och prislägen. Företaget arbetar uteslutande med modemedvetna kvalitetsmärken och erbjuder ett mycket attraktivt utbud av glasögon, solglasögon, linser och tillbehör. Vi har allt från klassiska bågar som Giorgio Armani, Chanel och Ray-Ban till mer designade som bågar från Oliver Peoples, Cutler and Gross och Dita mfl. Optiska produkter finns i en mängd olika utseenden och kvaliteter. Våra legitimerade optiker gör en ordentlig synundersökning för att sedan kunna rekommendera det mest lämpliga glaset i samråd med dig. Glasen vi använder är kvalitetsglas från japanska Hoya och tyska Zeiss.
